en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4760 - Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar (may Allah (swt) be pleased with him) wrote to Imam Abu Muhammad Al-Hasan ibn Ali (as)

asking about a woman who was divorced by her husband, and he did not provide her with maintenance (nafaqah) during her waiting period (ʿiddah) while she was in need.
"Is it permissible for her to leave and spend nights away from her home for work and to fulfill her needs?"

Imam  (as) replied in writing: "There is no harm in that if Allah knows her intention is sincere."
[chapter=CHAPTER 152 - CHAPTER ON DIVORCE DURING THE WAITING PERIOD (ʿIDDAH)
بَابُ طَلَاقِ الْعِدَّةِ
